VELVETMOVE.menu.title: Velvet Move — Footsteps & Hop
VELVETMOVE.menu.surfacesHint: Click a surface to make the current scene use it. Open the sliders to add sound files.
VELVETMOVE.menu.surfacesHintPlayer: The GM chooses the floor for each scene. You can still set your own volume above.
VELVETMOVE.menu.isoHint: This scene is being projected by Isometric Perspective — the hop is aligned to its projection.
VELVETMOVE.menu.label: Name
VELVETMOVE.menu.noSounds: No sounds yet — add a file or a whole folder.
VELVETMOVE.menu.assignHint: Pin this surface onto the selected tokens, whatever scene they are on.
VELVETMOVE.menu.deleteConfirm: Delete the surface "{name}" and its sound list?
VELVETMOVE.notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can change the scene's floor.
VELVETMOVE.notify.noSounds: That surface has no sounds yet.
VELVETMOVE.notify.emptyFolder: No audio files were found in that folder.
VELVETMOVE.notify.noSelection: Select one or more tokens first.
VELVETMOVE.notify.lastSurface: At least one surface has to remain.
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopEnabled.name: Hop on movement
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopEnabled.hint: Tokens lift off the floor and land again with each step they take.
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopHeight.name: Hop height
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopHeight.hint: How high a token rises, as a fraction of one grid cell.
VELVETMOVE.settings.stepLength.name: Stride length
VELVETMOVE.settings.stepLength.hint: Grid cells covered per step. Below 1 gives short, quick steps; above 1 gives long, loping ones.
VELVETMOVE.settings.ignoreElevated.name: Ignore elevated tokens
VELVETMOVE.settings.ignoreElevated.hint: Tokens above ground level (flying, on a ledge) neither hop nor make footsteps. Not applied under 3D Canvas, where elevation is also how every upper floor is expressed.
VELVETMOVE.settings.soundEnabled.name: Footstep sounds
VELVETMOVE.settings.soundEnabled.hint: Play a sound each time a token's step lands.
VELVETMOVE.settings.masterVolume.name: Footstep volume
VELVETMOVE.settings.masterVolume.hint: Your own volume for footsteps. Each surface has its own trim on top of this.
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.name: Whose steps you hear
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.hint: Which tokens' footsteps reach your speakers.
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.controlled: Only the token you are controlling
VELVETMOVE.settings.pitchVariation.name: Pitch variation
VELVETMOVE.settings.pitchVariation.hint: Randomly detunes each footstep so a short list of samples still sounds like walking.
VELVETMOVE.License.Settings.Name: Patreon licence
VELVETMOVE.License.Settings.Label: Manage licence
VELVETMOVE.License.Settings.Hint: Connect your Patreon account to remove the free-trial reminder, or release the installation slot to use it elsewhere. GM only — every feature works either way.
VELVETMOVE.License.TrialIntro: You are using Velvet Move in Free Trial mode — every feature is unlocked.
VELVETMOVE.License.TrialPitch: Join Patreon to support development, remove this reminder and unlock this module plus many more.
VELVETMOVE.License.TrialIntroPlayer: Your GM is using Velvet Move in Free Trial mode.
VELVETMOVE.License.TrialPlayerNote: Nothing for you to do — the table has every feature available.
VELVETMOVE.License.Cancelled: Authorisation cancelled. If the popup did not open, use the “I have a code” option.
VELVETMOVE.License.CodeHint: Paste the code shown after connecting your Patreon account.
VELVETMOVE.License.StatusActive: Licence active — {tier} subscriber. Thank you for your support!
VELVETMOVE.License.StatusTrusted: Licence verified. It revalidates on its own — you will not be asked again.
VELVETMOVE.License.ReleaseHint: Release the slot if you are moving your subscription to another server or browser.
VELVETMOVE.License.ReleaseConfirm: Release this installation? Velvet Move keeps working, but the free-trial reminder comes back until you connect again.
VELVETMOVE.License.MigrationTitle: Why am I being asked to connect?
VELVETMOVE.License.MigrationBody: Connecting is optional and always has been: every feature works either way. It only removes this reminder and supports development.
VELVETMOVE.menu.setupHint: Keep a setup and reuse it. Presets are JSON files on this Foundry installation, so every world on this server sees the same list. Export writes the same file to your computer.
VELVETMOVE.menu.savePresetHint: Saved as a JSON file under {folder}/ in your Foundry data directory.
VELVETMOVE.menu.pasteJsonHint: Paste a Velvet Move configuration here.
VELVETMOVE.menu.importPrompt: “{label}” carries {count} surface(s). How should it land?
VELVETMOVE.menu.importModes: Merge adds only surfaces this world does not have, leaving yours untouched. Replace swaps the whole library for the imported one.
VELVETMOVE.menu.addPathHint: Type or paste a path relative to your Foundry data directory.
VELVETMOVE.menu.setDefaultHint: Used by any scene that has not been given a floor of its own.
VELVETMOVE.notify.alreadyThere: Those sounds were already on this surface.
VELVETMOVE.notify.imported: Imported — {total} surface(s) in the library, {added} new.
VELVETMOVE.error.noFilePicker: This Foundry version does not expose a file picker Velvet Move can open.
VELVETMOVE.error.noUpload: You do not have permission to upload files to this server.
VELVETMOVE.error.emptyFolder: No audio files were found in “{folder}” or its subfolders.
VELVETMOVE.error.noSuchSurface: There is no surface with the id “{id}”.
VELVETMOVE.error.wrongModule: That file belongs to “{module}”, not Velvet Move.
VELVETMOVE.error.noSurfaces: That configuration carries no usable surfaces.
VELVETMOVE.settings.renderer.name: Renderer
VELVETMOVE.settings.renderer.hint: How this scene is drawn, which decides what direction the hop travels in. Leave it on automatic unless a scene is being projected in a way Velvet Move guesses wrong.
VELVETMOVE.settings.renderer.mismatch: You have forced a renderer the canvas is not using. It is currently drawing in:
VELVETMOVE.menu.rendererHint: How this scene is being drawn right now. The hop follows it: up the screen in 2D, along the projection in isometric, up the world axis in 3D.
